title: Ray Charles, James P. Johnson and Lil Armstrong's 'Brown Girl'
summary: Humes says Ray Charles is in a class by himself with real blues. Her first record was with James P. Johnson, whom she barely remembers. She plans to sing Lil Armstrong's 'Brown Girl' and recites it.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues
